title: phleum abbreviatum
intro: Phleum abbreviatum, commonly known as Short-tailed Meadow-grass, is a species of grass within the family Poaceae. This plant is rich in bioactive constituents and is used for its medicinal properties, which include the health benefits of anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects. The therapeutic actions of Phleum abbreviatum include its ability to calm the nervous system, reduce anxiety, and improve sleep quality due to its sedative and anxiolytic properties. The bioactive constituents of Phleum abbreviatum include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal and therapeutic effects.
